00079 /**

00089  *                            a previous call to HxMessageGetData.

00092  *
00093  * @return HxResult:  Returns HX_OK if the content is valid.
00094  *
00095  **/
00096 HxResult  HxPowerEventValidate (HxPowerMsgData_t *data, unsigned int size );

00115 /**
00116  * @brief       Retrieves "final" attribute of power event.
00117  *
00118  * When system is transitioning to sleep mode a serios of kHxModeSleep events is
00119  * broadcasted to notify application about mode change. In response to such events 
00120  * application could respond with HxPowerRequestSleepDelay call to buy more time 
00121  * to prepare for sleep. When no more "sleep delays" is requested the system will 
00122  * broadcast final kHxModeSleep event with "Final" atttribute set. This function 
00123  * retrieves the state of "Final" attribute.
00124  *
00125  * @param data        IN:     pointer to opaque type returned by
00126  *                            a previous call to HxMessageGetData.
00127  *
00128  * @return int:       Returns non-zero if "final" attribute of power event 
00129  *                            is set
00130  *
00131  **/
00132  int      HxPowerEventIsFinal (HxPowerMsgData_t *data );

00135 /**
00136  * @brief       Delay sleep
00137  *
00138  * This function will set the sleep countdown timer.  In the 'on' state,
00139  * it will set the timer to the value of 'keepalive_when_on' in 
00140  * powerd configuration file.  When not in the 'on' state, it will set the 
00141  * timer to the value of 'keepalive_when_not_on' in powerd configuration file.
00142  * Calling it repeatedly does not cause the delay time to accumulate.
00143  *
00144  * If the system is currently in 'On' state, the expiration of the sleep
00145  * timer will send it to the 'Ready' state.
00146  *
00147  * If the system is currently in 'Ready' state (just after power button
00148  * was pushed or lid closed), the expiration of the sleep timer will 
00149  * send it to the 'WaitSleep' state, where it will send a serios of 
00150  * kHxModeSleep events. 
00151  *
00152  * If the system is currently in 'WaitSleep' state, the expiration of the
00153  * sleep timer will send it to the 'Sleep' state, where all the drivers
00154  * will receive a HXPM_MODE_SLEEP event and the CPU will then be suspended.
00155  *
00156  * If application needs more time before transitioning into sleep mode, 
00157  * upon receiving kHxModeSleep event an application should respond with 
00158  * HxPowerRequestSleepDelay call to indicate that more time is required.
00159  * An application should continue responding to each kHxModeSleep event with
00160  * HxPowerRequestSleepDelay call until it is not ready to transition into 
00161  * sleep mode. An application should be ready to abort transitioning into 
00162  * sleep mode if indicated by kHxModeReady or kHxModeActive events.
00163  *
00164  * @return HxResult:  Returns HX_OK if successful.
00165  *
00166  **/
00167 HxResult HxPowerRequestSleepDelay(void);
